specs.Compatible Devices: laptops, smartphones, tablets, game consoles, PC, TV stick/box, DVD players, USB sticks

features: 【WIFI 6 Wireless Smart Projector】Say goodbye to traditional HDMI cable conversion projection, this smart projector is built-in WiFi6. Faster transmission rate and lower transmission delay, easily and quickly connect to smartphones, laptops, etc., within 5 seconds to connect successfully, to achieve fast and stable projection of video, games and so on.

【BT 5.0 & Speaker Function】The portable projector has built-in Bluetooth 5.0 chip and speakers, you can pair the projector with headphones, speakers or other audio devices via Bluetooth technology, or directly through the projector speakers to enjoy a cinema-quality audio-visual experience and enjoy videos anytime and anywhere.

【180° Rotatable Mini Projector】The projector base includes a 180° rotating bracket that allows you to orient the projector in various directions, from wall to ceiling. You can view at any angle from 40 to 130 feet with a clear image on the screen.

【HD Projection Screen】The movie projector offers a 40-130 inch projection screen with an optimal projection distance of 5.51 feet. Supports 4K 1080P, automatic horizontal keystone correction function provides you the best screen position.

【Wide Application】The portable projector has HDMI, USB, built-in 3.5mm headphone ports (please note that you need to buy the HDMI cable on your own), which is suitable for TV stick/box, game consoles, PC, smartphones, tablets, laptops, DVD players and USB sticks, and so on. Can be used for home theater, party, work and more.
